entries.850b4d459cb4c273: The company is headquartered in Mori, Shuchi District, Shizuoka Prefecture, and forms a group with 4 consolidated subsidiaries. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, and the number of employees as of December 31, 2025 was 206.
entries.8d646d561b280b90: Centered on planning and development of a wide range of small-lot products, with production outsourced to vendors suited to each product’s characteristics without owning production facilities, the company earns revenue from wholesale bases in Japan and Asia and from retail stores.
entries.93188ccacf2301fd: Its distinctive feature is a system in which small development groups collect diverse needs, and the company, which owns no production facilities, outsources production to the most suitable vendor for each product’s characteristics; this enables it to offer products in a wide range of small lots and launch many new products every year.
entries.9462b2cf68b41ccd: The filing’s section “Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address, etc.” states that the company adopts a system of small development groups to respond accurately to customer needs; that it owns no production facilities and outsources production to the most suitable vendor for each product’s characteristics; and that this system enables it to launch many new products and offset the decline in sales of existing products.
